ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity specular highlights localized to water droplets; background sky provides extreme macro-contrast against the fluke boundary.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface; absence of distinct contiguous high-contrast pigmentation blobs or mottling patterns.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch, approximately 45 degrees, forming a sharp vertex at the centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude jaggedness; left lobe displays prominent deep excisions and irregular peaks; right lobe displays a finer, continuous serrated profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the distal margins, tapering into sharp, upwardly-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and 'torn' geometry along the inner-to-mid trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant asymmetry in the trailing edge topography between the left and right lobes.
